name: the lead's bookings: what merging packages adds or saves together on the chapters route, and what a retirement saves (rulings K6, N1, O1, U2)
measuredWith: client-bundle.mjs bundleClient, as node build.mjs builds the client (dist/client-size-report.json: routes.chapters.code)
whatWasMeasured: Nothing of its own: this file books no package's bytes (ownBytes 0). Each item of sharedPoolBytes is a measured change of the chapters route that is no package's own, recorded under items with the builds it was measured on. Only this file may book a negative item (ruling O1). Created on rc44/wp2-s5-selection-fix-c2 (the second fix-up of wp2 slice 5) for the item of ruling U2, as ruling O1 describes the file; the lead reconciles it with the file of the same name on wp9a's branch (which books trackPathsPartNameO2, 0 B) at the merge.

allowance.of: the lead's own file books no bytes of its own; its items are the shared pool's. Of the saving booked below, 400 B are wp2's allowance (ruling U2: wp2 1,200 B = 600 B by A4 + 200 B by Q10 + 400 B of the saving), and the rest, 2,647 B, joins the shared pool (ruling U2)

guidedConcernRetirementQ8.ruling: U2 (wp2 slice 5, second fix-up): the saving of Q8's retirement of row 9, the guided comparison of a released concern (its start, answers, preparation, re-reading and preview, the comparison's builder on the route, the comparison tools' released-concern picker)
